high_level_description: The image is a screenshot of a Twitter post by Sidhant Sibal (@sidhant). The post features a photograph of the front page of "The Indian Express" newspaper dated May 16, 2014. The headline on the newspaper reads "Headline awaited," with additional text indicating that it was a special edition for the General Elections of India. The post includes a caption by Sidhant Sibal, which reads: "The iconic Indian Express 'Headline Awaited' banner of May 16th, 2014. Later that day election results of then Indian General Elections were announced.
